new.name: CVE-2026-58192
new.description: @appium/storage-plugin <1.1.6: POST /storage/delete passed name straight to path.join+rimraf with no sanitization — '../victim' escapes the storage root and recursively deletes arbitrary files/dirs, unauthenticated. Real handler 1.1.5 vs 1.1.6: victim deleted on vuln, validateStorageItemName rejects on fixed.

new.name: CVE-2026-61725
new.description: sevenz-rust2 <0.21.1: decompress_impl did dest.join(entry.name()) with no containment — a .7z entry '../../../../tmp/pwned' or absolute path writes outside the destination (Zip-Slip arbitrary file write). Real decompress_file 0.21.0 vs 0.21.1: escapes on vuln, safe_join rejects on fixed (ef760b6).

new.name: CVE-2026-63341
new.description: Aedes <1.1.1: a topic with >100 '/' levels reaches qlobber, whose synchronous 'too many words' throw is uncaught in the subscribe/publish handlers and kills the broker — one anonymous packet crashes it. Real broker 1.1.0 vs 1.1.1: crash (exit 1) on vuln, maxTopicLevels=100 rejects and stays alive on fixed.

new.name: CVE-2026-115565
new.description: storyblok-backup <0.7.1: writeJson concatenates the free-text component name into the backup path unsanitized — '../../pwned' writes outside the backup dir (stored second-order arbitrary file write). Real writeJson 0.7.0 vs 0.7.1: file escapes on vuln, sanitized/contained on fixed (f4e4bb1).

new.name: demo-cve-2025-57833
new.description: Uma aplicação vulnerável à CVE-2025-57833, e como consertá-la

new.name: CVE-2026-69261
new.description: Git LFS <=3.8.0: newRequestForRetry dropped only Authorization on host change and always copied Cookie — a cross-origin redirect leaks the victim's session Cookie to the attacker host. Real redirect handler v3.8.0 vs v3.8.1: Cookie forwarded on vuln, dropped on new origin (sameOrigin) on fixed.

new.name: CVE-2026-63386
new.description: js-toml <1.1.3: load() recursive parser/interpreter had no depth bound — a ~2KB deeply-nested TOML doc overflows the V8 stack and throws an uncaught RangeError, crashing consumers following the SyntaxParseError contract. Real load() 1.1.2 vs 1.1.3: RangeError on vuln, controlled depth-limit error (maxDepth=100) on fixed.

new.name: CVE-2026-104199
new.description: aMQTT 0.11.0-0.11.3: malformed '+' wildcard filter accepted via substring checks; _matches builds a backtracking regex (greedy [^/]* per '+') that holds the GIL and freezes the whole broker on one SUBSCRIBE+PUBLISH. Real broker 0.11.3 vs 0.11.4: SUBACK 0x00+freeze on vuln, 0x80+responsive on fixed.

new.name: CVE-2026-123007-NGINX2Root-detection-scripts
new.description: Detecta exposição ao NGINX2Root (CVE-2026-123007, CVE-2026-123633, CVE-2026-121810, CVE-2026-123634 e CVE-2026-113425), cinco falhas de execução remota de código no nginx corrigidas nas versões 1.30.7 e 1.31.9. Inventaria nginx.exe e   openresty.exe em disco, no PATH da máquina, em serviços Windows (diretos ou via NSSM) e em processos em execução.

new.name: CVE-2026-130176
new.description: aMQTT 0.11.0-0.12.0: outgoing QoS2 awaited PUBREC/PUBCOMP with no timeout — abandoned handshakes retain broker task/session/inflight state indefinitely, anonymous memory-exhaustion DoS. Real broker 0.12.0 vs 0.12.1: 200 flows retained (growth 200/400/600) on vuln, evicted after 5s on fixed.

new.name: CVE-2026-97555
new.description: CVE-2026-97555: heap overflow in the Linux SMB client DACL rewrite (cifs.ko) — analysis, POC, and an arm64 exploit chain ending in a uid-0 credential overwrite on the reference build

new.name: CVE-2026-99491
new.description: CVE-2026-99491 — wacom HID sibling UAF LPE (uhid → KernelSU temp root), 5.15 EXP.

new.name: CVE-2026-105802
new.description: Git LFS 0.6.0-3.8.0: LF embedded in a submodule config value forges an option under newline-split git config -l parsing, registering an attacker-chosen transfer binary (executed on fetch). Real pipeline v3.8.0 vs v3.8.1: forged entry+pwn adapter on vuln, NUL-separated parsing keeps LF in value on fixed.

new.name: CVE-2026-105803
new.description: Git LFS 1.3.0-3.8.0: crafted .lfsconfig key lfs.customtransfer.evil.path.access passes the safe-key filter and the unanchored tq regex registers an attacker-chosen transfer binary (executed on fetch). Real readGitConfig+tq v3.8.0 vs v3.8.1: evil adapter on vuln, anchored regex rejects on fixed.

new.name: CVE-2026-115463
new.description: Poweradmin 4.0.0-4.2.5/4.3.x/4.4.0: email 2FA code from mt_rand — state recoverable from self-minted codes makes a victim's 6-digit second factor predictable, with unlimited verify attempts. Real generator pre-fix vs fixed 021e5fea: seeded prediction matches on vuln, random_int independent on fixed.

new.name: CVE-2026-69260
new.description: Git LFS <=3.8.0: ssh.GetLFSExeAndArgs interpolates the .lfsconfig SSH URL path unquoted into the remote command — shell metacharacters inject statements on the remote host (RCE). Real function v3.8.0 vs fixed v3.8.1: ';touch /tmp/pwned' unquoted on vuln, single-quoted on fixed.

new.name: CVE-2026-115578
new.description: go-guerrilla <=1.6.7: XCLIENT handler sliced input[8:] but the verb is 7 bytes — a bare XCLIENT command panics (slice out of range) and crashes the SMTP daemon. Real daemon v1.6.7 vs fixed v1.6.7-1: panic on vuln, 250 OK on fixed.
